title: Require CI to pass before PR auto-merge (always-on CI Gate)
description:
Auto-merge currently squashes PRs immediately because main's branch protection has no required status checks. Add a single always-reporting 'CI Gate' required status check so auto-merge waits for Installer CI to pass.

Constraint: all PR workflows (installer.yml, checksum-system-tests.yml, toon-integration-tests.yml) use path filters. A naively-required path-filtered check blocks PRs that don't touch those paths (the check never reports). Solution: a 'CI Gate' that always reports — green when Installer CI passes OR is legitimately skipped, red when it fails — and require only that one context.

Must preserve direct-to-main commits for beads/docs (keep enforce_admins off; no required reviews / push restrictions).
close_reason: Added always-on 'CI Gate' aggregate check to Installer CI (PR #22, merged 1cb0cf48) and set branch protection on main to require only 'CI Gate' (strict=false, enforce_admins=false, no required reviews). Auto-merge now waits for CI; path-skipped PRs still pass via the changes-gated jobs + if:always() aggregator. Direct-to-main beads/docs commits preserved (admin bypass).

title: fix: dolt verified_installer runs as non-root user
description: The dolt installer (stack.dolt) has run_as: root in the manifest, but the code generator emits `| bash` instead of `| run_as_root_shell` for the verified_installer pipe. This causes dolt's install.sh to error: 'must run as root'. Root cause: generate.ts generateVerifiedInstallerSnippet() else-branch calls buildVerifiedInstallerPipe() which returns just 'bash'; the target_user case correctly uses run_as_target_runner but there's no equivalent for root. Fix: detect run_as === 'root' and emit run_as_root_shell as the pipe target, then regenerate scripts.
close_reason: Closed

title: [bug] gtbi doctor --fix does not handle identity.passwordless_sudo
description:
## Why this issue exists

`gtbi doctor` detects a failing `identity.passwordless_sudo` check and advises re-running the installer with `--mode vibe`, but `doctor --fix` had no handler for this check ID — it silently fell through to the unknown-check skip path.

The re-run advice itself is also broken: when the `user_setup` phase is already recorded as complete in the state file, a re-run skips that phase entirely and never calls `enable_passwordless_sudo`.

## What needs to be done

Add a `fix_passwordless_sudo` handler to `dispatch_fix` in `scripts/lib/doctor_fix.sh` that:
- Writes `/etc/sudoers.d/90-ubuntu-gtbi` with NOPASSWD for TARGET_USER
- Sets 440 permissions
- Validates with `visudo -c -f`
- Records the change for rollback

## Acceptance criteria
- `gtbi doctor --fix` repairs passwordless sudo without requiring a full reinstall
- Dry-run mode logs the planned action without writing anything
- Unit tests cover both cases
close_reason: Fixed in PR #18 (merged to main). Added fix_passwordless_sudo handler to dispatch_fix with dry-run support and 2 unit tests (67/67 pass).

title: Rehabilitate Installer Canary harness (PHASE 2.5+ pre-existing rot)
description:
The Installer Canary (Docker + Strict) schedules were PAUSED in PR #12 (commented-out cron, workflow_dispatch retained) because the harness has layers of pre-existing rot beyond the install-blocking lang.uv/~/.local/bin ownership fix.

Fixed in PR #12:
- lang.uv: ~/.local/bin pre-created root-owned in the non---skip-preflight path -> base.filesystem now owns it.
- Removed OBE verification of PR#7-removed tools (ntm, ru, dcg + hooks) and PHASE 2.7 test_new_tools_e2e.sh.

Remaining (canary still red after those, found via local ubuntu:25.10 repro of tests/vm/test_runner.sh):
- PHASE 2.5 (tests/vm/test_install_artifacts.sh): log_summary_cross_reference FAILs — install summary JSON reports status=failure and references /var/log/gtbi/install.log (root-install path) instead of /home/ubuntu/.gtbi/logs/. Root-vs-user log-path / status mismatch when install.sh runs as root directly (canary) vs via user. Passes standalone but fails in test_runner context.
- Likely further phases behind it (2.6 git_safety_guard removal, PHASE 3 idempotency) not yet validated end-to-end in the canary context.

Acceptance: tests/vm/test_runner.sh runs clean end-to-end in the canary Docker path for all matrix Ubuntu versions; re-enable the cron schedules in installer-canary.yml and installer-canary-strict.yml (uncomment the schedule: blocks).
close_reason: Canary harness green end-to-end (PR #20, merged 0c2dabc3). Root causes fixed: stale internal_checksums.sh from PR #18 (was aborting install before any phase, the real cause of the PHASE 2.5 status=failure/wrong-log-path symptom); PHASE 2.5 test now selects newest artifact instead of head -1; added check_dcg to doctor for PHASE 2.6. Verified via tests/vm/test_runner.sh across Ubuntu 24.04/25.04/25.10 (vibe) + 25.10 (strict), all green. Cron schedules re-enabled in both installer-canary workflows. CI on merge commit: all jobs green except pre-existing ShellCheck failure (web_checks test, tracked separately).
